hypotheses.justification: The statement only involves `AutomorphicForm.sigmaTensor K L (adicCompletion K v) σ` on `L ⊗[K] Kv`. `sigmaTensor` is defined (Def_AutomorphicForm_TwistedOrbital.lean, section Twist) under `[Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] (A) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]` only: it is the ring hom `Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ.toAlgHom (AlgHom.id K A)`. The completion `adicCompletion K v` and its K-algebra structure need `NumberField K` (so that 𝓞 K is a Dedekind domain), but they need nothing about L. The proof uses `sigmaTensor_pow` (same file, section Sigma, variables `[Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] (A) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]`) and `map_mul`, neither of which needs `NumberField L`. Adding `[NumberField L]` to the `omit ... in` line leaves the proof unchanged. There are no degenerate cases: the identity just says that a ring hom preserves multiplication.
